clips.title: The story
paras: Brother Nimetz seeks insight into the corruption of Colonel Kurzen by examining dark troll enchantments. Following Kurzen's Mystery, he asks you to venture south into Skullsplitter territory and secure fetishes from their spellcasters.

While reviewing the legends recovered from the jungle, Brother Nimetz turns his attention to the second troll tribe lingering further south. He suspects that dark troll sorcery may be responsible for Colonel Kurzen's descent into evil. To verify his theory, he asks you to venture into Skullsplitter lands and pry fetishes directly from their Witch Doctors and Mystics so he can study their magic at the Rebel Camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic. Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those fetishes, friend? They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...I must know!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you. I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
